source.autosprite_source_asset_name: Rabi Live2D SD Identity Source 20260606 v2
source.prompt: 32f acquisition loop: Rabi floats, breathes, long ear-wing appendages sway, halo/core glow pulse, blue eye blink, star wisps bob. Stable full body.
identity_locks: large ear-like side appendages from accepted SD companion sheet
white Casper-like ghost body with tapered tail
gold halo, shoulder/end-cap ring parts, and chest core
blue wisps and blue eyes retained across frames

processing.tool: Pillow per-cell deterministic repack + Real-ESRGAN alpha-preserved upscale + Lanczos downsample
processing.operation: AutoSprite 512 cells scaled to 84 percent and centered; transparent RGB alpha-bled before upscale; RGB cells Real-ESRGAN x4 upscaled to 2048 then Lanczos downsampled to 1024; source alpha Lanczos upscaled to 1024 and recombined.

qa.notes: Generated from the SD-identity Rabi source so the Live2D cut-in keeps the ear-wing appendages now accepted as the main identity. Final runtime sheet uses x4-super-sampled RGB downsampled to 1024px cells for a sharper 32-frame acquisition loop.
